items.section: One PresentInterval::Two, two opposite Direct3D mistakes
items.text: DIRECTX9 requests D3DPRESENT_INTERVAL_TWO without checking D3DCAPS9::PresentationIntervals or windowed mode; Reset can fail and retry every Present while public PresentationParameters keeps Two.

items.section: The public presentation-mode call reaches D3D11 and D3D12, but neither scales yet
items.text: DIRECTX9 stores PresentationMode and the virtual resolution but never reads them; every mode behaves like NativeBackBuffer.

items.section: MRT finalization across all bound targets
items.text: DIRECTX9 does not track an MRT set for finalisation: SetRenderTargets binds multisample surfaces of several targets but only a single tracked target is StretchRect-resolved on the next transition, so MSAA MRT targets may be sampled unresolved.
items.evidence: modules/renderers/directx9/src/DirectX9Renderer.cpp (SetRenderTargets comment 'MRT binds are NOT tracked'); D3D9RenderTargets.cpp (ResolveForTransitionEXT)

items.text: DIRECTX9 BasicEffect reaches only 12 of 32 variants; combinations without a matching CNA vertex layout throw 'no matching CNA vertex layout'; untextured VSBasicPixelLighting is permanently unproven.
DIRECTX9 RenderTarget2D ignores mipMap (single level; GetData level>0 throws NotSupportedException) and cube render targets ignore the MSAA request.
DIRECTX9 has no ClassifySurfaceFormatEXT, so public textures are Color-only although an internal D3DFORMAT mapping exists.
DIRECTX9 MultiSampleAntiAliasing and AnisotropicFiltering capability answers are unconditional defaults; D3DSAMP_MAXANISOTROPY is set unclamped by ApplySamplerState.
DIRECTX9 SetContextRecoveryEnabled throws after GraphicsDevice already stored the new flag (partial state change of the Texture2D shadow policy).

items.section: One public ShaderEffect API, two Direct3D contracts
items.text: DIRECTX9's draw dispatch has no branch for a custom ShaderEffect; only SpriteBatch consumes a D3D9 ShaderEffect.

items.section: Only D3D9 consumes the presentation format/fullscreen hook
items.text: DIRECTX11/DIRECTX12 never enter DXGI exclusive full screen (no SetFullscreenState; exclusiveFullscreen_ always false).

items.section: One PresentInterval::Two, two opposite Direct3D mistakes
items.text: No test measures PresentInterval::Two pacing or the no-vsync tearing branch on any Direct3D renderer; genuine DXGI device removal is never triggered; DIRECTX9 has no CI job and native-Windows runs are manual.

items.section: MRT finalization across all bound targets
items.text: MRT combined with mipMap=true on the DXGI renderers is wired through the same finalisation helper but no fixture combining them was identified.

items.section: Two frames in flight and blocking call sites
items.text: Former DIRECTX12 fixed-capacity descriptor heaps (exhaustion after 64 sampleable resources ever created) are absent: allocators reclaim and grow (REMED-GFX-177).

items.section: Clear: exact native bits do not imply one shared public contract
items.text: Former DIRECTX9 clear gating on the back buffer's presentation depth format is absent; the gate follows the bound attachment.

items.section: D3D12: shared foundations and split verification
items.text: Former DIRECTX11/12 collapse of PresentInterval to 0/1, fixed D24S8 depth, missing D3D12 scissor and missing D3D12 back-buffer readback are absent at the snapshot.

CNA prose inside TARGET is stale in places (plan calls D3D9 viewport/scissor oracle-proven; header comments list stencil and DSV as follow-up gaps; GraphicsRendererDescriptor.hpp says 45 of 46 renderers).
